faq.title: Common questions
faq.q1: Do guests need to download an app?
faq.a1: No. Vailo runs in the browser. Guests can add it to their home screen for one-tap access — it feels like an app without the App Store.
faq.q2: How does the AI know about my property?
faq.a2: The assistant is grounded in your house guide — rules, appliances, check-in details, and host notes you configure. It answers from your content, not generic travel advice.
faq.a3: Yes. Vailo is built for portfolios. Each listing gets its own portal, QR code, and house guide — managed from a single admin dashboard.
faq.q4: Is it available in multiple languages?
faq.a4: The guest portal and AI assistant support multiple languages. You can provide content in the locales your guests speak most.
faq.a5: Request a presentation and we'll walk you through setup. Existing partners can log in directly to the platform admin to configure properties and publish guest portals.
faq.q6: When do guests get access to the portal?
faq.a6: Guests receive the portal link as soon as the booking is confirmed. At the property, they can also scan a QR code that leads to the same portal.
faq.q7: How do commissions work for local partners and excursions?
faq.a7: Partners and excursion providers keep 100% of their own margin — Vailo doesn't take a cut from their price. Where Vailo earns its own referral margin, we share one third of it with you, the property owner or manager.
faq.q8: Can the AI assistant answer anything, or only what I configure?
faq.a8: The AI assistant only answers based on the house guide and content you configure. It won't invent information about your property, and it says so when it doesn't know something instead of guessing.
faq.q9: Does each property get its own portal and branding?
faq.a9: Yes. Every listing gets a unique portal, QR code, and house guide — with its own photos and tone — even when you manage everything centrally from one admin.
